planned.scene: Nao takes charge behind the counter of her grandfather's secondhand bookshop on its last day.
On a rainy afternoon, Nao and an adult visitor in a blue coat recognize the same thin ship-adventure book across the shop counter.
Nao places the ship-adventure book, cover facing outward, on the newly cleared shelf at the café next door.
